# Japan, April

Day 1–4 Tokyo: Shibuya, Asakusa temple early morning, day trip to Nikko.
Day 5 Shinkansen to Kyoto (JR Pass covers Hikari, not Nozomi).
Day 5–8 Kyoto: Fushimi Inari at sunrise, Arashiyama bamboo grove, Gion in the evening.
Day 9 Nara deer park, back to Kyoto.
Day 10 Osaka: Dotonbori street food, fly home from KIX.

Book ryokan in Kyoto with kaiseki dinner. Reserve the Ghibli Museum a month ahead.
